Markdown.Toolbar.Summarize.Tip: Summarise the whole document, section by section, with this workspace's Documents model. The summary opens beside it, a heading per section leading back to it.
Markdown.Toolbar.Translate.Tip: Translate the whole document into another language with this workspace's Documents model, keeping its markup, code and diagrams as they are. The translation opens beside it.
Markdown.Documents.NoModel: This workspace has no model in its Documents row. Choose one on the AI page of the workspace's configuration.
